claims.claim_vi: The source describes FCM: the client app sends Sender ID, API Key and App ID and receives a registration token (instance ID) that must be included in notifications; the client sends the token to the app server, which stores it with timestamps and removes stale tokens; messages are composed in a console or sent from the app server with the Admin SDK or HTTP; FCM queues them if devices are offline, forwards to platform-level transport, and routes them to devices which display them per configuration.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Own simulation, 2026-10-19, Python 3 with a fixed seed: 100,000 users, each month 3 percent reinstall (old token dead, new token issued) and 2 percent uninstall; after 12 months without cleanup 132,002 tokens were stored of which 53,455 (40.5 percent) dead; with deletion of dead tokens after 60 days of silence 82,391 were stored of which 3,844 (4.7 percent) dead; both policies ran on the same churn history (same seed), so live tokens were 78,547 in both, true by construction because the simulation only deletes tokens it knows are dead.
claims.section: Thử nghiệm: thẻ chết tích tụ
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session; parameters are the author's choice.

claims.claim_vi: Own simulation: a message sent at a uniformly random time while the device was offline, with the device back online after 1, 6, 24 or 72 hours, was still within its lifetime on arrival in 100, 63.9, 17.8 and 5.3 percent of runs with a 4-hour lifetime and 100 percent with a 28-day lifetime; ten updates with one key collapse to the last one.
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session; parameters are the author's choice, not FCM defaults.

claims.claim_vi: The bullets about FCM response codes, default lifetime, message collapsing and OS battery restrictions are the author's general knowledge and were not matched against Firebase documentation.

design_notes_vi: Khung một là năm bước của đường đi; khung hai là ba điều từ mô phỏng. Tham số mô phỏng là tự chọn.
source_deviations: The source's seven steps are grouped into three stages; the lesson adds two simulations (token accumulation, offline lifetime).
FCM-specific behaviours beyond the source (response codes, defaults, collapsing) were not checked and are flagged in the lesson.
